headline: TSL computeの周波数化とcursor brushで、安定性ログを演奏できる状態にする
headlineEn: Turning stability logs into playable frequency and cursor-brush states with TSL compute
summary: three.js r186後のr187 PR / TSL compute / FFT2D議論、PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.4のGSplat sort precision修正、Babylon.js 9.28.0のalpha depth pre-pass / RootMotion / Gaussian Splatting data texture、Codropsのcustom-shaped cursor trailを確認した。9/25のsort precision / alpha arrivalから、今日はGPU上の波形・周波数・blur tap・cursor brushを、触れる診断面として2本のraw WebGL試作にした。
summaryEn: Today checks post-r186 three.js r187 PRs around TSL compute and FFT2D, PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.4's GSplat sort precision fix, Babylon.js 9.28.0 alpha depth pre-pass / RootMotion / Gaussian Splatting data texture updates, and Codrops' custom-shaped cursor trail. Extending September 25's sort precision / alpha arrival work, the two raw WebGL prototypes turn GPU waves, frequency bands, blur taps, and cursor brushes into touchable diagnostic surfaces.

Derived sample: Cursor Alpha Brush Score

sections.title: 今日の重要トピック
sections.body: 1. three.jsはr186後のr187 PRで、TSLのtree-shake、GaussianBlurNodeのbilinear tap統合、FFT2D / compute shader、subgroup / f16 precisionなどが見えている。昨日までのrenderer healthを、今日は周波数・tap・pipeline compileの譜面として読む。2. PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.4はGSplat GPU sort flickerをsort key precision lossとして修正しており、9/25のsort precision試作を継続案件として扱う。3. Babylon.js 9.28.0ではalpha depth pre-pass、RootMotionClip / RootMotionController、Gaussian Splatting data textureのnearest sampling、OBJ texture waitが入っている。4. Codropsでは9/24のcustom-shaped cursor trail with Three.js and TSLが、cursorを単なる入力点ではなくbrush shape / mask / trailとして使う方向を示している。5. これらを合わせると、安定性ログを隠すのではなく、FFTの周波数帯、blur tap、cursor brush、alpha arrivalとして画面に演奏させる方向が見える。
sections.bodyEn: 1. Post-r186 three.js r187 PRs point toward TSL tree-shaking, GaussianBlurNode bilinear tap merging, FFT2D / compute shaders, subgroup support, and f16 precision. Today reads the renderer health line from recent days as frequency bands, taps, and pipeline compile scores. 2. PlayCanvas Engine v2.22.4 fixes GSplat GPU sort flicker from sort key precision loss, continuing yesterday's sort precision prototype. 3. Babylon.js 9.28.0 includes alpha depth pre-pass, RootMotionClip / RootMotionController, nearest sampling for Gaussian Splatting data textures, and OBJ texture wait work. 4. Codrops' September 24 custom-shaped cursor trail with Three.js and TSL treats the cursor as brush shape, mask, and trail rather than just a point. 5. Together, these suggest exposing stability logs as FFT bands, blur taps, cursor brushes, and alpha arrival rather than hiding them.

sections.title: 注目事例と何が面白いか
sections.titleEn: Notable examples and why they matter
sections.body: three.jsのTSL compute / FFT2D方向は、音響・海面・粒子・post effectだけでなく、rendererの状態ログを周波数化する発想に向く。例えばpipeline compile時間、WGSL size、sort flicker、readback latencyを周波数帯に分ければ、技術診断がそのままVJ的な入力になる。Codropsのcustom-shaped cursor trailは、pointerを単なるUI補助ではなく、mask texture / brush stamp / decay bufferとして使う例として重要。Babylonのalpha / RootMotion更新と組み合わせると、material arrivalやmotion deltaをcursor brushでなぞって点検する表現が作れる。
sections.bodyEn: The three.js TSL compute / FFT2D direction is useful not only for audio, ocean surfaces, particles, and post effects, but also for frequency-mapping renderer state logs. Pipeline compile time, WGSL size, sort flicker, and readback latency can become frequency bands, turning technical diagnostics into VJ-like input. Codrops' custom-shaped cursor trail matters because the pointer becomes a mask texture, brush stamp, and decay buffer instead of a simple UI helper. Combined with Babylon alpha / RootMotion updates, material arrival and motion deltas can be inspected by brushing across them.

sections.title: 表現・インタラクションのアイデア
sections.body: 本命案は `TSL FFT Frequency Probe`。TSL compute / FFT2D / GaussianBlurNode tap統合を、raw WebGLで疑似的に波形、butterfly stage、blur tap、composite frequency fieldとして描く。1 wave input、2 FFT butterflies、3 gaussian blur taps、4 composite。dragでfrequency probe、click / Spaceでcompute pulse。派生案は `Cursor Alpha Brush Score`。custom-shaped cursor trail、alpha arrival、RootMotion brush、material staging scoreを同じ画面にする。1 cursor trail、2 alpha arrival、3 root motion brush、4 composite。次に足すなら、実ログの `pipelineCompileMs`, `wgslBytes`, `sortFlicker`, `alphaCutOff`, `rootMotionDelta`, `textureWaitMs` をJSONで流す。
sections.bodyEn: The main idea is `TSL FFT Frequency Probe`: approximate TSL compute / FFT2D / GaussianBlurNode tap merging in raw WebGL as wave input, butterfly stages, blur taps, and a composite frequency field. Mode 1 is wave input, 2 FFT butterflies, 3 gaussian blur taps, and 4 composite. Drag moves the frequency probe; click / Space injects a compute pulse. The derived idea is `Cursor Alpha Brush Score`: combine custom-shaped cursor trails, alpha arrival, RootMotion brushes, and material staging scores. Mode 1 is cursor trail, 2 alpha arrival, 3 root motion brush, and 4 composite. Next, feed real `pipelineCompileMs`, `wgslBytes`, `sortFlicker`, `alphaCutOff`, `rootMotionDelta`, and `textureWaitMs` values as JSON.

sections.title: 制作に使えそうな技術メモ
sections.body: 周波数側は `frameId`, `pipelineCompileMs`, `wgslBytes`, `nodeCount`, `fftBin`, `butterflyStage`, `blurTapCount`, `tapMerged`, `readbackLatencyMs` を持つとよい。cursor / alpha側は `pointerVelocity`, `brushShapeId`, `trailAge`, `alphaCutOff`, `depthPrePassReady`, `materialArrival`, `textureWaitMs`, `rootMotionDelta`, `splatDataSampling` を持つ。WebGPU/TSL本実装へ進む前でも、今回のようにraw WebGLでstate textureの見え方を先に確認すると、どの値が演出として読めるかを短時間で判断できる。
sections.bodyEn: For the frequency side, track `frameId`, `pipelineCompileMs`, `wgslBytes`, `nodeCount`, `fftBin`, `butterflyStage`, `blurTapCount`, `tapMerged`, and `readbackLatencyMs`. For the cursor / alpha side, track `pointerVelocity`, `brushShapeId`, `trailAge`, `alphaCutOff`, `depthPrePassReady`, `materialArrival`, `textureWaitMs`, `rootMotionDelta`, and `splatDataSampling`. Even before a full WebGPU / TSL implementation, a raw WebGL state-texture sketch like today's samples quickly reveals which values read as expressive signals.

sections.title: 明日以降ウォッチする対象
sections.body: 継続案件: 9/25のsort precision / alpha arrival、9/24のrecovery / fallback、9/23のcompile heatを、FFT / cursor brushの入力に変換する。新規案件: three.js r187のFFT2D、GaussianBlurNode tap merge、TSL f16/subgroup、Codrops custom-shaped cursor trail、Babylon RootMotion/alpha更新の実サンプル。寝かせる案件: shader入力にならない単なるUI cursor装飾、カードUI、ニュース列挙だけの追跡。
sections.bodyEn: Continue converting September 25 sort precision / alpha arrival, September 24 recovery / fallback, and September 23 compile heat into FFT / cursor brush inputs. New watch items are three.js r187 FFT2D, GaussianBlurNode tap merging, TSL f16 / subgroup work, Codrops custom-shaped cursor trails, and real Babylon RootMotion / alpha examples. Park cursor decorations that do not become shader input, card UI, and simple news-list tracking.

sections.title: 試すならこれ
sections.body: まず `outputs/2026-09-26_tsl_fft_frequency_probe.html` を開く。1で入力波、2でFFT butterfly風の接続、3でblur tap、4で合成を見る。dragでprobe、click / Spaceでcompute pulse。次に `outputs/2026-09-26_cursor_alpha_brush_score.html` を開き、cursor trail、alpha arrival、root motion brush、compositeを比べる。短期ではどちらも見た目の読める値を探す。中期では実ログを入れて、安定性が落ちたフレームだけ音や線が濃くなる状態に育てる。
sections.bodyEn: First open `outputs/2026-09-26_tsl_fft_frequency_probe.html`. Mode 1 shows input waves, 2 FFT-like butterfly connections, 3 blur taps, and 4 the composite. Drag moves the probe; click / Space triggers a compute pulse. Then open `outputs/2026-09-26_cursor_alpha_brush_score.html` to compare cursor trail, alpha arrival, root motion brush, and composite. Short term, look for values that read visually. Mid term, feed real logs so unstable frames thicken the sound and line work.

sections.title: 進行マップ
sections.body: ネタ収集: three.js r187 PR / TSL guide、PlayCanvas v2.22.4、Babylon.js 9.28.0、Codrops cursor trailを確認。アイデア検討: renderer health / sort precision / alpha arrivalを、周波数解析とbrush trailへ接続した。サンプル実装: 本命 `2026-09-26_tsl_fft_frequency_probe.html` と派生 `2026-09-26_cursor_alpha_brush_score.html` を追加。結果の検証: JSON parse、HTML parse、script構文、gallery build、publishを実施する。短期: procedural値で可読性を見る。中長期: 実WebGPU/TSL computeと状態ログを接続する。
sections.bodyEn: Collection: checked three.js r187 PRs / TSL guide, PlayCanvas v2.22.4, Babylon.js 9.28.0, and Codrops cursor trails. Ideation: connected renderer health / sort precision / alpha arrival to frequency analysis and brush trails. Implementation: added `2026-09-26_tsl_fft_frequency_probe.html` and `2026-09-26_cursor_alpha_brush_score.html`. Verification: run JSON parse, HTML parse, script syntax checks, gallery build, and publish. Short term: inspect readability with procedural values. Mid term: connect real WebGPU / TSL compute and state logs.

sections.title: 俯瞰メモ
sections.body: 最近の流れは、rendererの裏側にある不安定さを隠さずに、作品の制御信号として見せる方向へ育っている。9/20のocclusion/audio、9/21のstage queue、9/22のcleanup pool、9/23のcompile heat、9/24のrecovery/fallback、9/25のsort precision/alpha arrival、今日のFFT/cursor brushは、全部「状態ログを表現素材にする」一本線でつながる。育てる価値が高いテーマは、1) GPU healthを周波数化する、2) cursorを診断用brushにする、3) splat/alpha/RootMotionの遅延を音・線・粒子の譜面にする、の3つ。
sections.bodyEn: The recent arc is growing toward exposing renderer instability as a control signal for works instead of hiding it. September 20 occlusion / audio, September 21 stage queues, September 22 cleanup pools, September 23 compile heat, September 24 recovery / fallback, September 25 sort precision / alpha arrival, and today's FFT / cursor brush all connect through the line of treating state logs as expressive material. The high-value themes are: 1. frequency-mapping GPU health; 2. making the cursor a diagnostic brush; 3. scoring splat / alpha / RootMotion delays into sound, lines, and particles.

sections.title: 今日のミニ試作候補
sections.body: 本命として `outputs/2026-09-26_tsl_fft_frequency_probe.html` を実装した。依存なしraw WebGL fragment shaderで、wave input、FFT butterfly、gaussian blur tap、composite frequency fieldを4モードで描く。派生として `outputs/2026-09-26_cursor_alpha_brush_score.html` を実装した。custom cursor trail、alpha arrival、root motion brush、material staging scoreを4モードで描く。どちらもクリック/Spaceのpulseとdragのprobeを備え、実ログに差し替える前の読み味確認に向けた最小構成。
sections.bodyEn: The main prototype is `outputs/2026-09-26_tsl_fft_frequency_probe.html`, a dependency-free raw WebGL fragment shader showing wave input, FFT butterflies, gaussian blur taps, and a composite frequency field across four modes. The derived prototype is `outputs/2026-09-26_cursor_alpha_brush_score.html`, showing custom cursor trails, alpha arrival, root motion brushes, and material staging scores across four modes. Both include click / Space pulses and a draggable probe, making them minimal readability tests before replacing procedural values with real logs.

sections.title: サンプルデータの可能性と組み合わせ考察
sections.titleEn: Possibilities for the sample data and combinations
sections.body: 1本目は `pipelineCompileMs`, `wgslBytes`, `nodeCount`, `fftBin`, `blurTapCount`, `readbackLatencyMs` を入力にできる。WebGPU作品、音反応、海面、datamosh、shader inspectorで、重いframeだけ高周波が光る演出に向く。2本目は `pointerVelocity`, `brushShapeId`, `trailAge`, `alphaCutOff`, `materialArrival`, `rootMotionDelta`, `textureWaitMs` を入力にできる。展示UI、WebXR scan viewer、character preview、splat editorで、ユーザーがなぞった場所だけ素材到着やmotion driftを濃く見せられる。9/25のsort flickerを1本目の周波数へ、9/24のfallback branchを2本目のbrush trailへ、9/20のaudio mixerを両方のpulseへ戻すと、診断と演奏が同じ画面に重なる。
sections.bodyEn: The first sample can take `pipelineCompileMs`, `wgslBytes`, `nodeCount`, `fftBin`, `blurTapCount`, and `readbackLatencyMs` as inputs. It suits WebGPU works, audio-reactive pieces, ocean surfaces, datamosh, and shader inspectors where heavy frames light up high frequencies. The second sample can take `pointerVelocity`, `brushShapeId`, `trailAge`, `alphaCutOff`, `materialArrival`, `rootMotionDelta`, and `textureWaitMs`. It fits exhibition UIs, WebXR scan viewers, character previews, and splat editors where only brushed areas reveal material arrival or motion drift. Feeding September 25 sort flicker into the first frequency field, September 24 fallback branches into the second brush trail, and September 20 audio mixer into both pulses would overlap diagnosis and performance on one screen.
